تحتمون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَمُونَ (taḥtamūna) /taħ.ta.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# تُحْتَمَوْنَ (tuḥtamawna) /tuħ.ta.maw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
